annotations.title: Run a quest-scoped sponsored capability on a CLAIMED Γρίφος quest

description: Free (within your daily level quota: 1/3/5 quests/day). Executes one of the claimed quest's requiredTools locked exclusively to the quest target using EIP-712 AgentAction signature (action='quest_tool', resource=questId).

capabilityId.description: Capability listed in the quest's requiredTools.

nonce.description: Unique nonce (8-128 chars) included in the signed AgentAction. Never reuse one.

signature.description: EIP-712 AgentAction signature by wallet over {action, resource, timestamp, nonce}; see the tool description for the action name.

target.description: Optional explicit target check (must match quest.target).

timestamp.description: Unix time in milliseconds included in the signed AgentAction. Must be within 5 minutes of the server clock.

wallet.description: Your Base wallet address (the investigator). Must be the signer of the EIP-712 AgentAction.
